providers.description: The accepted bundle evaluator signs, loads and evaluates a real self-test bundle.
Local-demo identity issuer: engine-issued, fingerprint-bound, revocable sessions. A deployed Keycloak is not required for the local-demo profile; this limitation is recorded in the C30 evidence.
Owned synthetic analytics upstream on loopback, reachable only through a verified gateway origin proof.

negative_uat: A synthetic decision fixture produces the expected allow outcome with an explicit reason.
Spoofed identity headers and direct origin access are rejected before policy evaluation and before any upstream side effect.
Revoked sessions, unavailable providers and expired bundles fail closed without displacing the active authority.
